extracted.intended_audience: general readers and 19th-century travel readers; historians and students of North African history and colonial-era travel narratives
extracted.subtask_description: A first-person 19th-century travel narrative chapter describing a journey through Fezzan (Mourzuk to Sockna), with observations on geography, local people, slavery, politics, and customs. The text is literary and documentary rather than prescriptive or evaluative.
